Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to import tasks from other projects in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on August 31, 2026.

How does this affect me?
With this feature, you can select and import tasks from one or more existing projects into a new project; eliminating the need to create tasks manually.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Add support to import tasks from other projects.

Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Add support to import tasks from other projects
